arg.name: image
arg.description: The color (or mono) image of the RGB-D camera.

arg.name: depth
arg.description: The depth image registered to the image (16UC1 in mm or 32FC1 in m), e.g. aligned_depth_to_color/image_raw of realsense2_camera.

arg.name: camera_info
arg.description: The camera info of the image.

arg.name: method
arg.description: Method of the odometry: rgbd (the photometric error of the image), icp (the geometric error of the depth) or rgbd_icp (both).

arg.name: max_depth_diff
arg.description: Maximum difference (m) of the depths of the corresponding points of the images.

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Queue size of the synchronized subscribers.

arg.name: odom_frame
arg.description: Frame of the odometry, the robot (base_frame) at the start.

arg.name: base_frame
arg.description: Frame of the robot, whose TF to the sensor is given (e.g. base_link, base_footprint), or empty for the frame of the sensor.

arg.name: publish_tf
arg.description: Publish the TF odom_frame -> base_frame; with it at the start, the node subscribes the inputs always, for the subscribers of /tf.

arg.name: path_length
arg.description: Number of the poses of ~/path, the trajectory for rviz, 0 for all of them.
